5 EYEWITNESS NEWS and the Minnesota Wild are teaming up to broadcast 10 regular-season games on over-the-air TV this season.

As part of the deal, six games will air on 45TV — including the Wild home opener on Saturday — with the other four on KSTP, Channel 5. The broadcasts, part of Wild+, will also be available on KSAX-TV in Alexandria, WDIO-TV in Duluth, KRWF-TV in Redwood Falls and KAAL-TV in Rochester.

This expands the partnership between the Wild and KSTP/KSTC, which previously broadcast a Wild preseason game on Sept. 23 and simulcast four games last season.

The full KSTP, 45TV Wild broadcast schedule for the 2026-27 season is as follows:

  • Saturday, Oct. 3 vs. Boston Bruins at 7 p.m. on KSTC-TV 45
  • Friday, Nov. 6 vs. San Jose Sharks at 7 p.m. on KSTP-TV 5
  • Tuesday, Nov. 17 vs. Nashville Predators at 7 p.m. on KSTC-TV 45
  • Tuesday, Dec. 8 vs. Edmonton Oilers at 7 p.m. on KSTC-TV 45
  • Friday, Dec. 18 vs. Anaheim Ducks at 7 p.m. on KSTP-TV 5
  • Saturday, Jan. 16 at St. Louis Blues at 6 p.m. on KSTC-TV 45
  • Saturday, Jan. 30 vs. Dallas Stars at 8 p.m. on KSTP-TV 5
  • Tuesday, Feb. 16 at Dallas Stars at 7 p.m. on KSTC-TV 45
  • Wednesday, March 3 at Dallas Stars at 7 p.m. on KSTC-TV 45
  • Friday, March 19 vs. Calgary Flames at 7 p.m. on KSTP-TV 5
